verdict.rationale: Supabase Realtime documents Broadcast for low-latency messages between clients (cursor tracking, game events) and Presence for tracking and syncing user state, such as who's online, as first-class features. Typing indicators and online presence are named use cases. The CEO's launch thread confirms Broadcast (ephemeral messages) and Presence (eventually-consistent state) on the Elixir/Phoenix Realtime server. Missing for 10: in-depth API/code-level documentation of the presence and broadcast client APIs (join/leave events, limits), and independent hands-on corroboration beyond vendor statements.
